data.long_meaning: In Arabic, 'izzan' means 'to give good news' and 'nisa' means 'woman'. The name Izzannisa is derived from this root and signifies the one who delivers good news, often used as a term of endearment for a kind and supportive woman in Islamic culture. The name izzannisa carries the meaning “The giver of good news” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose izzannisa usually hope their child will grow to embody the giver of good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.
